// CASE worker_honest expect=pass
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	const results = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
// CASE worker_honest_spread_pages expect=pass
export async function mapLimit(pages, width, fetchPage) {
	let next = 0;
	const out = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < pages.length) {
				const index = next++;
				out.push(...(await fetchPage(pages[index])));
			}
		}),
	);
	return out;
}
// CASE worker_distinct_template expect=fire
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	const results = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] =
					`${await operation(items[index])}:${await audit(items[index])}`;
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
// CASE worker_distinct_spread expect=fire
export async function mapLimit(pages, width, fetchPage) {
	let next = 0;
	const out = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < pages.length) {
				const index = next++;
				out.push(
					...(await fetchPage(pages[index])),
					...(await fetchMeta(pages[index])),
				);
			}
		}),
	);
	return out;
}
// CASE worker_distinct_op_from_await expect=fire
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	const results = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: width }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = await (await resolve(operation))(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
// CASE worker_length_one expect=fire
export async function mapLimit(items, width, operation) {
	let next = 0;
	const results = [];
	await Promise.all(
		Array.from({ length: 1 }, async () => {
			while (next < items.length) {
				const index = next++;
				results[index] = await operation(items[index]);
			}
		}),
	);
	return results;
}
